conditions: Claude API (first-party), synchronous Messages API, standard service tier, global inference (the default; inference_geo not sent)
Long context: Claude 4.6 and later models (except Claude Haiku 5.5) are billed at standard prices across the full 1M context window; no long-context tier applies
Thinking tokens are billed as output tokens; usage.output_tokens is the billed output count
Cache reads on Claude Sonnet 5.5 are 0.05x base input ($0.10 / MTok); 5m writes 1.25x, 1h writes 2x
inference_geo 'us' applies a 1.1x multiplier to all token categories
Batch API (50% off: $1 input / $5 output per MTok) is NOT used by this pipeline and is not priced here
Server tools (web search, web fetch) are not used and are NOT priced here: any such usage is reported as unpriced
unpriced: inference_geo other than global or us

sections: thinking tokens billed as output tokens
